howto: Pick a critter, then race three rivals over a 460 m obstacle course after the 3-2-1 countdown.
Jump rocks, logs, spikes, gaps and boulders; slide under hurdles.
Run through ? crates for an item (lightning, glove, saw, mine, boost or shield) and use it to get ahead.
First across the finish wins; your best winning time is saved.
tips: Double jump: tap jump again in the air to clear a boulder or a long gap.
Brown mud drops you to about half speed for a moment, even in the air.
Lightning stuns everyone ahead of you, so it is best when you are behind.
Drop a mine when a rival is right on your tail.
A stun always ends with a moment of safety: use it to run clear.

controls.keyboard: Enter or Space starts a race. Space, W or Up to jump (again in the air to double jump), S or Down to slide, F or Shift to use an item, M mute. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap to jump, swipe down to slide, tap the item button to use an item.

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title set the rivals' pace (7% slower on Easy, 5% faster on Hard). Rivals also rubber-band around you, so every race stays close.

cheats.effect: A new item the moment you use one

features.position-or-lap-hud: Place badge (1st to 4th) top left and a progress bar with every racer's marker
features.results-with-time: The results list every racer's finishing time (or metres to go) and your place
features.best-time-or-ghost: Best winning time on the title and the results, with NEW BEST TIME
features.results: YOU WIN! or YOU PLACED card with all four times, best time and Race again
features.tutorial: First race: three prompts (jump, slide, use an item), each cleared by doing it; Skip, and Replay tutorial in How to play
features.hints: Hint names the next hazard and its distance, or how to use the item you hold
